title: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋：从巅峰到调查
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: NVIDIA is really in its biggest crisis in its three decade history of operation.
segments.zh: 英伟达正经历三十年来最严峻的挑战。

segments.en: There's all the components right now of a huge drama.
segments.zh: 目前各种要素齐备，一场大戏正在上演。

segments.en: In the last few days, NVIDIA's CEO, Jensen Wong, has been at the center of a firestorm.
segments.zh: 过去几天，英伟达CEO黄仁勋一直处于风暴中心。

segments.en: CEO Jensen Wong has admitted to having an extramarital affair after reports he was targeted by a suspected Chinese spy.
segments.zh: CEO黄仁勋承认有婚外情，此前有报道称他成为疑似中国间谍的目标。

segments.en: American officials suspect she fed information to China and also helped to smuggle advanced AI chips into the country.
segments.zh: 美国官员怀疑她向中国传递信息，并协助将先进AI芯片走私到该国。

segments.en: Jensen Wong said to have had a relationship with an NVIDIA executive who reports to him.
segments.zh: 黄仁勋据称与一位向他汇报的英伟达高管有恋情。

segments.en: With these stunning revelations, Wong's judgment is being called into question.
segments.zh: 这些惊人爆料使黄仁勋的判断力受到质疑。

segments.en: And he's now the focus of internal and government investigations.
segments.zh: 他现在是内部和政府部门调查的焦点。

segments.en: But just a few weeks ago, things were looking very different.
segments.zh: 但就在几周前，情况还截然不同。

segments.en: Hi, Jensen. Hi, Jensen. Hi, Jensen.
segments.zh: 嗨，黄仁勋。嗨，黄仁勋。嗨，黄仁勋。

segments.en: Hi, Jensen. So this is Jensenity. Thanks for having us on this trip, kicking it off in Paris.
segments.zh: 嗨，Jensen。这就是Jensenity。感谢让我们参与这次旅程，从巴黎开始。

segments.en: Yeah? In October, we followed NVIDIA's CEO across Europe at the height of his power, traveling to four countries in four days.
segments.zh: 是吗？十月，我们跟随英伟达CEO走遍欧洲，正值他的巅峰时期，四天访问四国。

segments.en: The leader of the leading AI chipmaker appeared to be on a mission to sell the world on a revolution powered by NVIDIA chips.
segments.zh: 这家领先AI芯片制造商的领导者似乎肩负使命，要向世界推销由英伟达芯片驱动的革命。

segments.en: We invested $8 billion in Europe, and so $8 billion worth of jobs is a lot of jobs.
segments.zh: 我们在欧洲投入了80亿美元，80亿美元的工作岗位意味着大量就业。

segments.en: The chipmaker has poured billions of dollars into startups, frontier labs, and data centers, and Wong seemed like a man-defined gravity.
segments.zh: 这家芯片制造商向初创企业、前沿实验室和数据中心投入了数十亿美元，黄仁勋似乎是一个定义引力的人。
Jensen plowing 正在接受调查。
